comparison.objective: Candidate separates ceramic finishing media from metal washers through a physical screen; PR seats an add-on PCB onto header pins without bending them.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests granular flow, orientation-dependent passage, bridge clearing, washer retention, and bimanual screen handling; PR tests low-tilt aligned pressing with damage-sensitive force control.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires ≥98% media recovery, every washer retained, no spill/damage, and released screen support for 3 s; PR requires the board seated within 0.3 mm, no historical bend, stillness, and gripper clearance for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Material separation through apertures is meaningfully different from precision multi-pin insertion; both rubrics provide sufficient numeric outcome and damage criteria.
